rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for living temporarily in a tent or similar accommodation.

example.english: We’re going to camp this weekend.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 go3 zau1 mut6 heoi3 lou6 jing4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a place where people stay in tents or other simple temporary accommodation.

example.english: We spent one night at the camp.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 jing4 dei6 gwo3 zo2 jat1 maan5

rows.note: Use this for an organised holiday or youth camp as an event or programme.

example.english: The kids joined a summer camp this year.
example.traditional: 細路今年參加咗夏令營。
example.jyutping: sai3 lou6 gam1 nin4 caam1 gaa1 zo2 haa6 ling6 jing4

rows.note: In games, use this for staying put at a useful location or beside an item in order to gain an advantage.

example.english: We’ll camp on the high ground in the game and wait for the enemies to come over.
example.traditional: 遊戲入面我哋守住高地，等敵人行埋嚟。
example.jyutping: jau4 hei3 jap6 min6 ngo5 dei6 sau2 zyu6 gou1 dei6 dang2 dik6 jan4 haang4 maai4 lai4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a military camp, base, or barracks.

example.english: This military camp does not let outsiders in.
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 gwan1 jing4 m4 bei2 haan4 jan4 jap6

rows.note: Use this specifically for putting up or arranging the camp itself, rather than merely staying there.

example.english: We’ll set up camp first, then go swimming.
example.traditional: 我哋先搭營，陣間先去游水。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sin1 daap3 jing4 zan6 gaan1 sin1 heoi3 jau4 seoi2

rows.note: Use this figuratively for a faction or side whose members share strong political or ideological views.

example.english: That camp is always attacking the opposing side online.
example.traditional: 呢個陣營成日喺網上鬧對家。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zan6 jing4 seng4 jat6 hai2 mong5 soeng6 naau6 deoi3 gaa1

rows.note: Use this for deliberately acting affected, showy, or theatrically over-the-top, rather than for the neutral meaning of camping.

example.english: They camp it up all the time; even when gaming, they have to act ridiculously over the top.
example.traditional: 佢哋成日扮嘢，連打機都要扮到好誇張。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 baan6 je5 lin4 daa2 gei1 dou1 jiu3 baan6 dou3 hou2 kwaa1 zoeng1
